summary: Verified Personnel Management annual leave allocation now supports both days and hours. Backend PersonnelCreate/Update accept annual_{vacation,sick,holiday}_{days,hours} and persist correctly (verified via GET). Defaults on create when omitted: 15/360, 12/288, 11/264. Frontend Add/Edit Personnel dialogs render all 6 inputs with correct data-testids (vacation/sick/holiday - days/hours-input). Changing Days auto-calculates Hours (x24): 20->480, 10->240, 8->192. Editing Hours independently does NOT change Days (verified). Personnel table renders leave allocation in V:15d/360h / S:12d/288h / H:11d/264h format. Edit dialog pre-populates existing values correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: PersonnelManagementPage.js is 1462 lines - consider splitting the Add/Edit dialog into its own component for maintainability.

Hours field state is stored as string when user edits directly (setAnnualVacationHours(e.target.value)) but as int when auto-calculated from days. Consistent numeric handling would prevent potential type mismatch when submitting to backend. Backend currently coerces via Pydantic int, so no functional bug.
Auto-calc uses parseInt(days) * 24 which yields NaN when input is cleared; the `|| 0` fallback handles it, but leaves Hours=0 after clearing Days which may surprise users.
seed_data_creation: Test personnel TEST_LH_001/TEST_LH_002 created and deleted during backend tests.
